_comment: Coverage ratchet baselines (#185), consumed by scripts/coverage_gate.py.
Measured on main by the coverage CI job (MODE=cov, gcc-14, Linux arm64,
unit + int with both reference models, run 2026-08-03) and rounded DOWN
to whole percent. Raising after an improvement is routine; lowering
requires a justified, reviewed edit. null = not yet measured, which the
gate treats as a failure that prints the measured value.
floors are hard minimums outside the ratchet. src/io (the malformed-GGUF
parser surface) is at the intended 35% parser-security floor since #219:
GGUF buffers + tiny synthetic safetensors files, no fixtures), so the
previously fixture-gated safetensors half no longer skips on CI — raise
the floor with the coverage, do not let it drift down.
